title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: Eric Henson is a citizen of the Chickasaw Nation and has been a research fellow/affiliate with the Harvard Project on Indigenous Governance and Development (formerly known as the Harvard Project on American Indian Economic Development) since 1998. He is also the inaugural Director of the Ittapila Program for Nation Building Education and Outreach at Harvard University. Mr.
